html:
The Croatian War of Independence was fought from 1991 to 1995 between Croatia and Serb rebels backed by the Yugoslav army and Serbia, after Croatia declared independence on 25 June 1991.

Serbs in the old Military Frontier areas and Slavonia, fearing a Croatian state, set up the Republic of Serbian Krajina. With army help they took about a quarter of Croatia, besieged Vukovar and shelled Dubrovnik. A ceasefire in 1992 brought United Nations troops. In 1995 Croatia retook most of the land in Operation Storm, and Eastern Slavonia was returned peacefully in 1998. About 20,000 people died. The war was part of the breakup of Yugoslavia.
sum: The Croatian War of Independence was fought from 1991 to 1995 between Croatia and Serb rebels backed by the Yugoslav army and Serbia, after Croatia declared independence on 25 June 1991.
